reason: Teardown is named `dispose` everywhere and means one thing: release resources, safe to call twice (documented once on AudioProcessor and Param). `[Symbol.dispose]()` (key `*.Symbol.dispose`) calls it for the `using` protocol.
The AudioContext the object was built with; the name and the `BaseAudioContext` type say it all.
Web Audio connection point named like AudioNode input; the contract (`undefined` when there is none) is documented on AudioProcessor.
Web Audio connection point named like AudioNode output; the contract is documented on AudioProcessor.
Frozen registry of the owner's ReadonlyCells; the shape is the generic argument and the rule is documented on AudioProcessor.
Static class-name discriminant (`"Compressor"`, `"Filter"`…) used to serialize and recreate effects; the literal says it.
Discriminant of an applyEdits operation: its literal value is the operation's name, documented on the operation type itself.
Literal discriminant (`"audio" | "midi"`, `"webclap" | "rack"` …); the union of literals says what it is.
Opaque id string of the object it sits on; ids are never parsed, only compared and passed back (docs/vocabulary.md).
Display name of the object it sits on; not unique and never interpreted (docs/vocabulary.md).
JSON Schema `type`, always "object" for an operation's input; the JSON Schema meaning is standard.
Literal discriminant of a rack effect slot (`"filter" | "delay" | "eq"`); the literal says which effect it is.
